svg.title: How Helengine reaches the PlayStation 2
svg.desc: A C# editor and shared runtime become generated C++ plus handwritten PS2 code

g.text: A C# editor and shared runtime become generated C++ plus handwritten PS2 code
What exists on the development machine
How authored content becomes a console runtime
Generated core meets handwritten platform code
Generated C++ linked into PS2 runtime
Opaque draw, textured draw, pretransformed draw
The editor is not shipped to the PS2
Core owns update, scenes, entities, content
Runtime reads cooked assets; files writes them
The editor and builder stay C#
The player receives generated core, not the editor
Two C++ sources become one player
The linker produces the EE executable
VU1 transforms and shades; GS produces the image
